captions.detailed: This 3D model is a customizable wire rack featuring an array of eight vertical tines arranged in a row. The tines are rectangular in cross-section, featuring a small angled support brace at their base and a short, backward-angled lip at their top ends. The rack is supported by a thin, flat base plate that extends horizontally, ending in rounded, circular tabs on each side. Each of these tabs contains a central countersunk mounting hole designed for screw attachment.
captions.instruction: Create a parametric wire rack with an adjustable number of tines, tine dimensions, and tine spacing. The base plate should automatically scale in width based on the number of tines, feature rounded circular ends, and include countersunk screw holes for easy mounting.
captions.factory: The base plate is constructed by unioning a central cube with two cylinders at either end. A difference operation subtracts two sets of concentric cylinders representing the countersink and screw holes. A for-loop instantiates the tines using cubes, where each tine consists of a main vertical cube, a base support cube rotated at 45 degrees, and an upturned top lip cube rotated at -30 degrees.
